The date and the sky

attestedThe text says: “on Saturday, the middle of Shawwāl” (يوم السبت للنصف من شوال), vol. 2, p. 100. English is an AI draft.

Case: Which Saturday?

attestedQuraysh fought the Prophet at Uḥud in Shawwāl of the third year. (section 1192, vol. 2, p. 59)

attestedUḥud took place on a Saturday in the middle of Shawwāl. (section 1267, vol. 2, p. 100)

  • computedbefore lunation: Friday 1 March 625
  • computedtabular lunation: Saturday 30 March 625 (matches the text)
  • computedafter lunation: Monday 29 April 625

The weekday in the text and the computed weekday are kept apart. A mismatch is a question for the scholars, never a correction.
